title: word_freq + merge_intervals
prompt:
Write two functions in one fenced ```python block:
1. `word_freq(text: str) -> dict` returning a dict mapping each lowercased whitespace-separated word to its count.
2. `merge_intervals(intervals: list) -> list` merging overlapping or touching closed [start, end] intervals and returning a sorted list.
Include both functions. No prose outside the block.
